what: PORYGON2 v1 — the value net on the full honest-information state, trained on search-improved targets. Written 2026-09-26 BEFORE any v1 training run, any deep label was read into a fit, and any v1 arena game.
why: The ladder showed the search (MILTANK + gen5 nets) loses most games opponents play out (3-11 excluding forfeit wins, docs/_reports/2026-09-26-click-outcomes.md) and self-play generations 6-9 plateaued against gen5 (docs/_reports/2026-09-25-machamp-warm-loop.md). The value net is the suspected bottleneck.
baseline: gen5's PORYGON2 (solver/machamp/models/gen5/porygon2-gen5.json), the net inside the current champion (solver/machamp/league/gen5.json)

data.corpus: MEW self-play on the release, league solver/porygon2/v1/corpus-league-p2.json: current = gen5 nets in MILTANK k 4x4, 1 reserved switch row, depth 0, a fixed 2-pass cap (32 playouts, no clock); opponent = current 0.6 / the DODUO-v1 human clone 0.4; TRAIN team pairs; omniscient (the MEW default); cap 50 turns; seeds 1001, 1002, ... -> solver/out/selfplay/eaa5becc54eb/p2v1-c<k>
data.earlier_selfplay: gen0, gen1, r2-sp0, r2-sp1, r3-sp0, loop-sp6..loop-sp9 (10,200 games on the same release, read only)
data.human: solver/out/human/games.jsonl of the main checkout (dataset sha256 9d07c522...), every position, the MAG/DODUO player split
data.encoding: solver/porygon2/v1/build.js: self-play games replayed exactly on the release (replay_mismatch must be 0) and encoded from the true battle through the honest producer; human games from their public history. gen5's value is stored per row for the paired gate.

targets.selfplay_exact: y = v_exact: small endgames (1v1, 2v1, 1v2 live mons), a recursive LP solve over every joint, 3 dice per cell, 2 turns deep (1 when the root has > 20 joint pairs); labelled `exact` only if every branch ended the game
targets.selfplay_deep: y = 0.5 z + 0.5 v_deep; v_deep = mean of the root values of MILTANK run from BOTH seats with k 6x6, 1 reserved switch row, a fixed pass cap, depth 0, gen5's leaf and gen5's MAG/DODUO (solver/porygon2/v1/label.js); a 2-turn endgame solve that used a leaf (`deep2`) counts as deep
targets.selfplay_other: y = 0.75 z + 0.25 v_root (the recorded play-time root, p1 frame, roots at most half empty) when present, else z

training.architectures: two arms on the same data: `sets` (Deep Sets, token 64, head 128-64) and `attn` (one pre-LN attention block over 12 mon + 2 side + 1 field tokens, d 32, 2 heads, ffn 64, head 96-48); both antisymmetric by construction
training.selection: per arm, the epoch with the lowest combined validation loss (human val log-loss vs z + self-play val loss vs y, equal weight)
training.arm_choice: the arm with the lower combined validation loss goes forward; `attn` is used only if its median leaf cost (bench.js) is at most 1.5x gen5's on the same positions, otherwise `sets`
training.threads: torch at most 6 threads; the whole process under 4 GB

gates.a_heldout: PASS iff the 95% upper bound (bootstrap over games) of (v1 - gen5) log-loss against the OUTCOME is < 0 on BOTH (i) held-out human test positions (a test player's view) AND (ii) held-out self-play test positions (the 10% game-hash test split of the directories gen5 never trained on: r3-sp0, loop-sp6..9, p2v1-c*). Brier reported beside it, with CIs, and by turn bucket (turns 1-3 separately).
gates.b_calibration: a 10-bin reliability table and plot for v1 and gen5 on both test sets, with the expected calibration error; reported, not a pass/fail gate
gates.c_sprt: MILTANK with v1 vs MILTANK with gen5 nets (both: gen5's MAG + DODUO, k 4x4, 1 reserved switch row, depth 0, 1,000 ms per decision = equal wall-clock), solver/machamp/sprt.js --info honest, elo0 0, elo1 +20, alpha = beta = 0.05, pair scores in index order, at most 2,000 games, TEST team pairs of the frozen pool cycled, battle seed 9101; PASS iff H1. Read once at the bound; no interim LLR.
gates.d_vs_doduo: MILTANK with v1 vs DODUO-greedy (the human clone), the same SPRT machinery and parameters, honest, battle seed 9102; reported
gates.land: only if a and c pass (and parity + the RED-on-break tests are green). Otherwise commit on the branch and report.

parity: solver/tests/test-porygon2-v1.js: the Node forward pass against Python float64 logits on raw rows of the exported model, worst |diff| <= 1e-9; RED under PORY2V1_INFER_BREAK=mask and each PORY2V1_BREAK (honest, protect, tr)
